src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: Court-drawn congressional plan (final judgment of Dec. 30, 2011, Smith v. Hosemann, S.D. Miss. three-judge court, consolidated with Buck v. Barbour)
Clearinghouse, Buck v. Barbour (Dec. 30, 2011 final judgment, Smith v. Hosemann, S.D. Miss. No. 3:01-cv-855) - secondary

The Legislature passed no plan after the 2010 census; the court amended its 2002 plan. Four districts, used 2012 through 2020. Census file basis: the Bureau's user note says its 116th Congress and 2018-election-year legislative districts carry no later changes.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: All About Redistricting, Mississippi (court plan Dec. 30, 2011; JR 1 and JR 201 passed May 2-3, 2012; JR 202 of Mar. 27, 2019; HB 384 signed Jan. 24, 2022; JR 1 and JR 202 of Mar. 31, 2022) - secondary

No House election in 2020 (elected 2019, 2023; specials aside). Census file basis: the Bureau's user note says its 116th Congress and 2018-election-year legislative districts carry no later changes. The legislature's own resolution could not be reached; source is secondary.
